answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on three popular datasets for NLG metrics meta-evaluation, which range over two tasks: summarization - QAGS ; and story generation - HANNA .

answer_2.quote: Since large language models (LLMs) that exhibit strong instruction-following abilities became available, the NLG community has increasingly adopted LLMs as automatic text evaluators .

answer_3.quote: Following their experimental setup, we prompted an open-source LLM to analyse the given text, identify error spans related to a specific aspect and provide an output in the form of explanation triples and a final score.

answer_4.quote: Every story was then evaluated by three annotators on six criteria.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation of over 90% of examples with the highest score remains unaffected by increasing error severity using any of the proposed perturbations.
